items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I just happen to have been one of the people that came out of the New Orleans African-American style... It started with Louis Armstrong... I just happen to be one of those people who learned it from the ground up

ctx.x: I was listening to Harry James, but not extensively.
Were you listening to Louis Armstrong’s records?
Yeah. Louis Armstrong made an indelible... The band he had, Hot Five, and those
